# AlgoRythm

> Browser-based text-to-music composer. Write simple text patterns and hear them play with drums and synth engines.

AlgoRythm turns plain text into music. Each line is a track; tokens on the line play on consecutive ticks of a shared grid. Drum tokens trigger samples; pitched tokens (like C4, E4) play through synth voices.

## Pages

- [Composer](/): Live text editor with playback, BPM control, and per-track mixer.
- [Syntax Guide](/syntax): Reference for the AlgoRythm pattern language — tracks, tokens, rests, and pitches.
- [Instrument Library](/library): Every supported instrument command with descriptions and example patterns.
